title: Additional FSI for Redevelopment of Existing Residential Housing Societies (Non-Cessed)
scope: Redevelopment of existing NON-cessed residential co-op housing societies (or landlord-owned buildings) where existing members are re-accommodated on the same plot.

eligibility.age_reckoned_from: Date of Occupation Certificate OR first date of property tax assessment; whichever is on record with MCGM
eligibility.existing_bua_condition: Existing authorized BUA must be MORE than Zonal (basic) FSI

incentive_additional_bua_formula.RC: Rate of construction per sqm as per ASR
incentive_additional_bua_formula.LR: Rate of developed land per sqm as per ASR (for FSI 1)
incentive_additional_bua_formula.alternative_flat_incentive: 15% of existing BUA OR 10 sqm per tenement, whichever is more, free of premium
incentive_additional_bua_formula.note: Both formulations appear — DCPR text has amendments layered.

case_A_low_existing_bua.action: Society avails additional-FSI-on-premium/TDR up to permissible FSI of 2.0

case_B_high_existing_bua.action: Society gets incentive additional BUA in lieu of cost of construction of existing BUA, above permissible FSI 2.0

interaction_with_permissible_fsi_of_2.reg_45_exception: For redevelopment under Reg 45, full incentive additional BUA is available as TDR

staircase_lift_lobby_treatment.if_previously_free_of_FSI_with_premium: Those areas remain free of FSI without further premium (to that extent)
staircase_lift_lobby_treatment.if_previously_counted_in_FSI: Incentive additional BUA also given on those areas; they may be availed free of FSI on payment of premium per current Reg

fungible_compensatory_area_reg_31_3.on_incentive_additional_BUA: Free of premium (in lieu of cost of construction of authorized existing BUA)

in_situ_fsi_cap.unconsumed_bua_handling: TDR under DCPR provisions; plot potential perpetually restricted to consumed BUA under this Regulation

mixed_tenanted_and_society_plot.condition: Tenanted building/s AND co-op housing society (non-tenanted) buildings co-exist on same plot
mixed_tenanted_and_society_plot.treatment: Proportionate land component (based on existing authorized BUA of tenanted portion) developed under 33(7)(A); remainder notional plot under 33(7)(B)

cross_references.reg_31_3_fungible: Free on existing authorized BUA and incentive additional BUA
cross_references.reg_30: Society may avail regular FSI-on-premium/TDR up to permissible FSI 2.0
cross_references.reg_45: Special treatment — full incentive as TDR

extraction_gaps.calculator_status: PENDING — needs a 33(7)(B) feasibility to validate the (RC/LR)-based incentive formula and TDR handling before authoring Reg33_7B_Calculator.php
